title: 美债回购扩至320亿：赤字却纹丝不动，信号还是行动？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: yields have bounced right back and they're higher across the curve today even after he indicated that treasury could increase the buybacks even more than
segments.zh: 收益率已经反弹，今天整个曲线上的收益率都更高，即使他表示财政部可能将回购规模增加到超过首次宣布的40亿美元。

segments.en: the 4 billion first announced. Your read here is the White House's desperate?
segments.zh: 您认为这是白宫的绝望之举吗？

segments.en: Absolutely yeah let's be honest about what they're doing here this is a plea for lower borrow and cost three months out from midterm elections and it's not going to do anything it's signaling but really it's not even signaling
segments.zh: 绝对是的，让我们坦诚面对他们正在做的事情。这是在中选前三个月为降低借贷成本而发出的恳求，但这不会起任何作用。这是信号，但实际上甚至不是信号。

segments.en: to the market it's signaling to the voters because they're not going to get anything across in this market you know we're talking about a treasury market that's more than 30 trillion dollars
segments.zh: 这是向选民发出的信号，因为他们在这个市场上不会得到任何东西。我们谈论的是一个超过30万亿美元的国债市场。

segments.en: you know 32 billion dollars in buybacks per quarter is not going to not going to move things around here
segments.zh: 每季度320亿美元的回购不会在这里改变什么。

segments.en: and as you alluded to and also as Mary Daley alluded to this is a global phenomenon going on in the in the long end of the curve right
segments.zh: 正如您和玛丽·戴利所提到的，这是全球范围内长期收益率曲线的现象。

segments.en: there's a sea change going over going on over in Japan which is experiencing real inflation for the first time in a quarter century or so
segments.zh: 日本正在发生巨大变化，大约四分之一个世纪以来首次经历真正的通胀。

segments.en: you know central banks around the world are pulling back support from their balance sheets and so big things are happening around the world
segments.zh: 世界各地的央行正在缩减资产负债表支持，因此全球正在发生大事。

segments.en: and in the areas where the where the treasury could actually be doing something like say you know these 6% deficits which have become persistent
segments.zh: 而在财政部可能真正有所作为的领域，比如那些持续存在的6%赤字，他们实际上没有采取任何行动。

segments.en: they're not actually doing doing anything so this is a desperate attempt to sort of throw their hands up and and and say we're trying here we're trying
segments.zh: 所以这是一种绝望的尝试，他们摊开双手说：我们正在努力，我们正在努力。
